summary: Verified admin login bug fix (api.js + AdminLogin.jsx) end-to-end in dev. All 24 UI assertions passed: wrong-password shows 'Invalid email or password.' (no detail row for 401), unreachable-backend simulation (window.fetch overridden to throw TypeError) surfaces 'Cannot reach the backend.' with a data-testid='admin-login-error-detail' row containing the attempted backend URL and reason — the exact actionable UX the fix was designed to produce for the production failure mode. Happy path login redirects to /admin/jobs and token is persisted in sessionStorage under 'infotron_admin_token'. Full admin CRUD verified: create → appears in admin list and on public /careers → job detail page loads with all apply-form data-testids → unpublish removes it from /careers → edit updates admin list → delete removes row (confirm() auto-accepted). Session persists across reload; signout clears token and redirects to /admin/login. Backend health confirmed via curl (GET /api/jobs 200; POST /api/admin/login returns JWT). No admin password hash, bcrypt hash, or JWT secret appear in any surfaced error message — error text only contains the configured BACKEND_URL and a generic CORS/network explanation.

issues: Minor: on 401 the error block is concise which is correct, but screenshot shows a cookie-consent banner overlapping lower parts of the viewport on small heights — not caused by this fix.

critical_code_review_comments: api.js: good — fast-fail when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL missing, network errors wrapped as ApiError(status=0) with .url + .cause. No sensitive info leaked.
AdminLogin.jsx: branching on err.status (401 / 0 / other) is clean and the detail row is conditional. getBackendBaseUrl() returns '(not configured)' fallback when env missing — good.
The fix correctly addresses the reported prod symptom: an unset REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL on Vercel will now show a clear 'Backend URL is not configured…' message instead of a generic failure.
Admin page is noIndex so surfacing the backend URL in the error is acceptable; still, consider masking the host behind a 'Show details' toggle if you later remove noIndex.
seed_data_creation: Created a 'TEST QA Engineer <timestamp>' job during the run; it was deleted at the end of the test. Admin list is empty on completion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login error-UX contract: 401 -> error block text 'Invalid email or password.' with NO data-testid='admin-login-error-detail'. status=0 (fetch throws) -> error block text starts with 'Cannot reach the backend.' AND a data-testid='admin-login-error-detail' child containing both the configured BACKEND_URL and a CORS/network reason. To simulate the prod outage mode, override window.fetch via page.evaluate before clicking submit.
